description: Registry of stable Vibra linter and compiler codes (reference for tooling)

codes.summary: Invalid atom literal; atom names use lowercase kebab-case dot segments
Unknown atom in a contextual keyword position
Contextual keyword position requires an atom; bare symbols are the pre-atom spelling
Invalid token or character in native S-expression syntax
Unterminated string literal or unescaped newline in a string
Invalid string escape
Malformed, non-finite, or out-of-range numeric literal
Unexpected closing parenthesis
Unclosed S-expression list
Invalid top-level S-expression form
Unknown or misplaced semantic form head
S-expression form has the wrong number of operands
S-expression child has the wrong grammar kind
Unknown, duplicate, missing, or misplaced trailing labeled attribute
Unsupported source extension for the S-expression frontend
Embed or template expansion has not been cut over to the typed S-expression frontend
Typed macro invocation has the wrong number of arguments
Typed macro syntax category does not match its parameter, result, or invocation position
Typed macro body produced no syntax
Typed macro compile-time binding or expression is invalid
Typed macro conditional does not contain boolean syntax
Typed macro expansion exceeded its recursion depth
Typed unquote, splice, or capture is malformed or misplaced
Typed macro evaluation exceeded its step budget
Typed macro expansion exceeded its generated-node budget
Imported macro is private to its defining module
Typed macro uses an explicitly unsupported definition or module syntax category
Primitive operation has invalid arity, operand types, or mixed types
Checked integer primitive operation overflowed its declared type
Integer division or remainder by zero
Integer shift count is outside the declared type bit width
$function must use canonical labeled shorthand; implicit subject, nested envelopes, and $void plus args are forbidden
$let must bind exactly one name per invocation
Malformed `$mut` expression or type wrapper
`$set` must contain exactly one existing symbol and value
`$set` target is unknown, immutable, or a read-only reference
`$set` value is incompatible with the target pointee type
Malformed `$ref` expression or type wrapper
`$ref` target cannot be resolved
Reference access mode is invalid for its target
$function.do must be a block sequence, not nested $do wrapper
Use $do for multi-step sequencing outside $function.do
$if requires keys is, then, else
String interpolation not allowed except blessed stdlib forms
Structured `$match: { target, arms }` form is not canonical; use `$match: <expr>` with sibling `when:` arms
`$match` arms must use `case`; legacy `pattern` keys are forbidden
Import cycle detected
A module references an import alias that it does not declare directly
Variance / subtyping audit marker
Symbol-like key is not kebab-case
$wasm encoding does not match active compiler WASM mode
Unknown annotation key on a top-level definition (recognised `=`-prefixed annotations: `=doc`, `=where`; further additions documented per phase)
Legacy un-prefixed annotation key (`where:`, `doc:`); v1 annotations must use the `=` prefix (rename to `=where`, `=doc`)
`=where` bound list element does not resolve to an interface (or `$intersect` of interfaces). Bounds may be a registered `$interface` alias, an inline `$interface`, or an `$intersect` of those.

Type argument supplied to a generic call site or a generic type-position instantiation does not satisfy its declared `=where` bound. Satisfaction requires a nominal `=impl` block on the implementing type for each interface in the bound. Also raised by interface-qualified dispatch (`$iface.method`) when the dispatch argument's type has no matching `=impl`.

Interface-qualified call (`$iface.method`) targets an interface method that has no `$self`-typed argument, so dispatch is impossible. Use the type-qualified form `$<implementing-type>.<iface>.<method>` instead.

Interface-qualified call's `$self` argument has a generic static type. Dispatch through generics requires monomorphisation, which is not yet implemented in v1; pass a concrete value or call the type-qualified form.
`=doc` annotation must be a string scalar (YAML `|` block or quoted string)
Bare reference to a generic type alias requires explicit instantiation `{ $alias: { tparam: T, ... } }`
Generic alias instantiation is malformed (unknown alias, missing param, unknown param name, or arity mismatch)
Implicit coercion between a `$newtype` and its inner type is forbidden; use `$cast`
Malformed `$newtype` definition body
`$cast` has no valid v1 cast path between source and target types
Malformed `$cast` payload; expected `$cast: <expr>` with sibling `into: <type>`
Opaque host handles are runtime-minted and cannot be created with `$cast` or literals
Reserved `$self` type used outside an `$interface` body or a type's `=defs` / `=impl` annotation
Invalid `=defs` annotation (placed on a non-type definition, entry is not a `$function`, or duplicate inherent op name)
Invalid `=impl` annotation (placed on a non-type definition, malformed payload, or method binding that is neither a `$function` envelope nor a qualified function alias)
`=impl` keyed by an alias that does not resolve to a registered `$interface` type
`=impl` block missing a binding for one of the interface's `=where` type-parameters or one of the interface's methods
`=impl` payload contains an unexpected key (not `=where`, an iface type-arg, or an iface method name)
`=impl` method signature does not match the interface declaration (after `$self` and iface type-arg substitution)
`=impl` method alias does not resolve to a registered function
Noncanonical option representation; use the tagged stdlib option enum instead of `$option` sugar or a direct `$void` union member
Malformed effect: `(effect ...)` takes exactly a domain and an action atom
Reserved effect syntax: operands beyond the domain and action are reserved for handler definitions, and effect-row tails are reserved for effect polymorphism
Returned value type does not match the declared return type
`match` over an enum is missing an arm for one of its tags; add the arm or a `_` arm
`match` over an open-ended type requires a `_` arm; a single literal arm is only total when the target is that literal's singleton type
`=comment` annotation must be a string scalar
`=lint` must contain exactly a non-empty `disable` array of known lint codes or `all`
`=comment` and `=lint` must share a mapping with the syntax they describe
Call argument type does not match the parameter type; no implicit numeric widening or narrowing occurs
Invalid opaque host handle type
Unknown versioned host module or import
Host import argument arity or exact value type mismatch
Host import wrapper return type mismatch
Static wasm dependency or artifact is missing or invalid
Static wasm artifact does not export the requested function
Static wasm wrapper and exported function signatures differ
Unknown or unsupported typed plugin interface
Runtime plugin path or wasm artifact is invalid
Runtime plugin load authority was not granted
Runtime plugin requests ambient imports or authority
Runtime plugin is missing a declared function export
Runtime plugin function signature does not satisfy its interface
Validated runtime plugin could not be instantiated
Value is not a supported traversal source
Integer range step is zero
Traversal length exceeds configured or platform limits
Integer range arithmetic overflow
Internal traversal index is negative or out of bounds
Structured task capture is unknown, duplicated, mutable, or reference-typed
Structured task body or control flow is malformed
Affine task handle is copied, joined more than once, or leaves its scope unjoined
Compilation flag is not a kebab-case name
Conditional source filename contains a malformed flag suffix
Compilation flags were supplied while running a precompiled application
LSP compilation flag settings have an invalid structured shape
Compile-time template options are malformed
Compile-time template path is invalid or escapes its package
Compile-time template file is unreadable or not valid UTF-8
Compile-time template syntax is malformed
Compile-time template lookup is missing or not scalar
Compile-time template exceeds source, output, or nesting limits
Benchmark iteration configuration is invalid
Anonymous function use requires deferred first-class closure support
Duplicate test scenario name in a module
Duplicate test case name in a scenario
